name: img2threejs
description: Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural, quality-gated, animation-ready Three.js model. Token-efficient image-to-3D.
readme: Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural Three.js model. Quality-gated, animation-ready, and deliberately token-efficient — reconstruction-by-code, not photogrammetry, mesh extraction, or downloaded art packs. Reference images reconstructed in code as animation-ready Three.js models, running live in the browser.
